verdicts.reason: The two layouts are nearly identical, and both have the same problems. The dark logo panel touches the top edge of the canvas but sits inset from the left. The orange divider is stranded on its own above 'LIMITED SUMMER RELEASE', and that tagline is placed under the logo instead of leading into the headline, which breaks the reading order. The right column is cramped: the legal text is around 5px, unreadable, and jammed under the CTA, and the button nearly touches the right edge. B wins narrowly because its body copy starts lower, so it isn't crowding the top edge as much as in A, and it sits better above the button.
